residents.name: the Long Count
residents.kind: a woman who counts and an animal that walks: a line of years in trees, pointed at the thing she cannot reach
residents.situation: On the north-east side of Foothill Woods, about 170 blocks from the world tree and 163 from Route 3, stands a lean-to with a lit fire and, beside it, a spruce pole forty-odd blocks high with a lantern on top and a ladder up one side: from the road it shows as a light over the canopy. Perrin Hale lives under the lean-to. North-east of her, on a ring of moss, sits a Grotle, and from the Grotle a lane eleven blocks wide runs off north-east through the wood, a hundred blocks long, rising a little, with a young tree at every eighth pace, smallest at the Grotle and tallest at the far end, and beside each tree a fence post with a sign: YEAR 13, YEAR 12, down to YEAR 0, and a cold camp. The Grotle sets out every spring, walks eight paces toward the world tree and sits down; a seedling is where it sat. Perrin has counted thirteen springs. She has not been under the tree's roots in nine years (her knee) and wants to know whether they still bear: show her a Sitrus Berry off them and she says so, and gives what the Grotle leaves behind, dried. At the oldest tree, under YEAR 0, a tin is set into the ground.
residents.story_rule: a small thing the world tree is only the horizon of; nothing in the arc. The Grotle is not a prophecy and the line is not a path to anything: Perrin knows the tree will not be reached in her lifetime and counts anyway. The one fact she states about Pokemon is true in Cobblemon 1.8.0 (species/generation4/grotle.json): at level 32 a Grotle becomes a Torterra, and with a sapling held it wears that tree. Tier 3 (Foothill Woods), gated at gym 2.

The camp is 163 blocks from the nearest Route 3 path point, Perrin 165, the Grotle 165 and the tin 204; the camp is 170 from the world tree's centre; docs/world-building/LONG_COUNT.md has the search that chose it.
